title: Baked Zucchini frittata

media.caption: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and then mix with the Canestrato cheese, zucchini and parsley.
Preparing the baking dish for the oven.
The frittata fresh out of the oven, ready to be served.

healthBenefits.title: Hydration & Low Calories
healthBenefits.text: Zucchini is over 90% water and low in calories, making this dish light while still filling.

healthBenefits.title: High-Quality Protein
healthBenefits.text: Eggs provide complete protein with all essential amino acids, supporting muscle repair and satiety.

healthBenefits.title: Bone Health
healthBenefits.text: Canestrato cheese is rich in calcium and phosphorus, essential for strong bones and teeth.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil supplies monounsaturated fats and antioxidants that support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Boost
healthBenefits.text: Parsley adds vitamin C and vitamin K, contributing to immune function and bone metabolism.

healthBenefits.title: Muscle & Tissue Support
healthBenefits.text: The combination of eggs and cheese offers a strong protein profile beneficial for muscle maintenance.

_ingredientsText:
8 zucchini
6 eggs
1 cup Canestrato cheese, grated
1 tablespoon parsley, chopped
4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
salt
_preparationText:
1 - preparazione delle zucchine
2 - 4 precottura delle zucchine
5 - In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and then mix with the Canestrato cheese, zucchini and parsley.
6 - preparazione della teglia per il forno
